body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature you can perceive declares an Action or Reaction.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally affected by one of your Rites. It gains +1 Defense against the triggering effect or +1 die on its next Reaction to it.

surges.html: Increase the range or duration of this Reaction's ritual effect by 1 unit or through the end of the turn.
Spend 1 Mana; after this Reaction resolves, immediately resolve one of your Rites' Echoes once without reducing remaining Echoes.
